about: GTA 6 stash house where everyone is already dead: a player's launch-day loot video (TikTok @schlayerr, posted 2026-11-19) shows a red building in South Vice-Dale County near the start of the map; break open the door, the people inside are already dead, loot a Type-9 SMG, a Duke 556 assault rifle, stash bags filled with product, a safe with cash and a card he sold for $6,000; about $17,200 total, he says, without killing anyone. Commentary mode (SAFE-EDIT rule 10): three muted creator clips, facecam and captions cropped out, each annotated, credit in the description only. Delta.

lines.text: In GTA 6, there's a stash house where everyone's already dead.
lines.say: In G T A six, there's a stash house where everyone's already dead.

lines.text: It sits close to where the game starts.
Break open the door, and the crew inside is already down.
An SMG, an assault rifle, and stash bags.
lines.say: An S M G, an assault rifle, and stash bags.

lines.text: The back room has even more to bag.
Then a safe with cash, and a card he says is worth $6,000.
lines.say: Then a safe with cash, and a card he says is worth six grand.

lines.text: His total: about $17,000, without a single kill.
lines.say: His total: about seventeen thousand dollars, without a single kill.

lines.text: So who hit this place before you got there?
lines.say: So, who hit this place, before you got there?
